name: Astral Backstep
description: Each Astral Fatigue stack triggers a brief astral displacement, pulling you backward. The disturbance may collapse your fatigue entirely or intensify it if the astral shift destabilizes.

name: Astral Challenger I
description: A dangerous astral flare that sharpens frostbite and draws enemy focus. Astral Fatigue erupts into repeated frost pulses, rapidly compounding frostburn as long as the surge holds. This can not fully be implemented yet

name: Astral Challenger II
description: A dangerous astral flare that sharpens frostbite and draws enemy focus. Astral Fatigue erupts into repeated frost pulses, rapidly compounding frostburn as long as the surge holds. This can not fully be implemented yet

name: Astral Charge
description: Channels astral force to charge one tile toward the target.

name: Astral Charge 5
description: Charges forward up to five tiles toward the target using astral displacement.

name: Astral Sidestep 2
description: Shifts position two tiles using astral displacement.

name: Astral Sidestep 3
description: Shifts position three tiles using astral displacement.

name: Astral Sidestep 4
description: Shifts position four tiles using astral displacement.

name: Astral Burning Light
description: Creates a small astral light on targets and adds a burning light effect to skills.

name: Astral Echo
description: adds a 20% chance to repeat the ability with your second weapon

name: Frostbite Convergence
description: Astral frost converges into a volatile surge, expanding your spell’s area while converting a portion of damage into frostbite stacks. Frostbite intensifies, amplifying astral chill interactions.

name: Frostburn Nova
description: Converts damage into frostbite and frostburn stacks, then detonates them for bonus damage. Expands the spell’s area and intensifies frostbite. Allies are unaffected.

name: Astral AoE Expansion
description: You distort astral geometry, expanding the area of your next spell while shortening its casting reach. The widened impact zone overwhelms nearby foes but forces you to channel the spell from closer range.

name: Astral Clarity Surge
description: You fracture astral flow to accelerate your casting rhythm, unleashing your next spell with greatly reduced cast time and cooldown. The surge restores a random ability’s cooldown, converts a portion of your damage into life, and empowers distant attacks through astral resonance.

name: Astral Overdrawn
description: You force unstable astral power through your channels, causing your next spell to strike twice and inflicting heavy Overdrawn strain on yourself. Any effects applied by that spell collapse instantly when you cast another ability, and the surge sharply increases the spell’s cooldown before burning out.

name: Astral Tempo Break
description: You fracture astral flow to accelerate your casting rhythm, nearly instantaneously unleashing your next spell while sharply reducing its cooldown and extending its duration. The surge restores two random ability cooldowns, making this augment ideal for regaining tempo in critical moments.
